info.title: Airline Management API - Flights
info.description: Endpoint migrated from the legacy VB.NET FlightsForm delete action (BtnDelete_Click). Deletes a flight by its numeric ID. Only administrators can see the delete action in the legacy UI, so this endpoint requires an authenticated admin session.

delete.description: Deletes the flight with the given ID. Migrated from the legacy BtnDelete_Click handler in FlightsForm. The legacy flow was: (1) get the selected flight ID from the grid (GetSelectedFlightId); (2) if no flight is selected, show 'Please select a flight.' (this maps to 400 Bad Request); (3) call FlightRepository.Delete(id), which runs 'DELETE FROM Flight WHERE id = @id'; (4) on success, reload the flight list. The legacy code does not check whether a row existed, so deleting a non-existent ID also succeeds (204). Any database exception is reported as an error (500).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the flight to delete. Maps to the 'Id' column (Convert.ToInt32) of the selected row in the legacy grid.

204.description: Flight deleted successfully. No content is returned (legacy: 'Flight deleted successfully!' message).

400.description: Invalid flight ID (not a valid integer, or no flight selected in the legacy flow).

401.description: Unauthorized. No valid authenticated session (legacy: SessionManager.IsAuthenticated() is false).

403.description: Forbidden. The authenticated user is not an admin (legacy: SessionManager.IsAdmin() is false, so the Delete button is hidden).

500.description: Internal server error. A database or other exception occurred while deleting the flight (legacy: 'Error deleting flight: ' & ex.Message).

example.message: Error deleting flight: 23503: update or delete on table "Flight" violates foreign key constraint

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token for an authenticated admin session. Replaces the legacy SessionManager in-memory session.
